title: AID Frontend User Outcome Contract
$comment: C2 lens content for frontend_user_outcome (FC-35). Row registered in review-checkpoint-contracts.md. Dispatch: observe (C2 -> E10, not blocking in E7, D5).
description: Defines the expected user-visible outcomes for a frontend feature. Used by C2 semantic review to verify user-facing behavior over real data.

persona.description: Target user type -- who this feature serves (e.g. 'logged-in customer', 'PM reviewing plan')

user_questions.description: 1-5 questions the user should be able to answer using this UI

actions.description: User-visible actions enabled by this feature (e.g. 'submit form', 'view dashboard')

data_oracle.description: Source of truth for verifying user-visible data correctness

source.description: Where to fetch expected data (e.g. API endpoint, DB query)

comparison.description: How to compare UI output to oracle (e.g. 'field equality', 'contains subset')

significant_states.description: UI states that must be tested separately

success.description: One-sentence definition of what 'works correctly' means for this feature
